license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

issuing_authority.quote: The state board of podiatry, herein referred to as the board, shall have the following powers

name.quote: The state board of podiatry, herein referred to as the board

type.quote: The state board of podiatry, herein referred to as the board, shall have the following powers

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses
umbrella_agency.quote: To authorize, by written agreement, the division of occupational and professional licenses as agent to act in its interest.

age_minimum.quote: Each applicant shall be at least twenty-one (21) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: shall not have been convicted, found guilty, or received a withheld judgment or a suspended sentence in this state or in any other state of a crime that is deemed relevant

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) or equivalent from accredited podiatry school
degree_required.quote: shall be a graduate of some reputable school of podiatry accredited by the board. A reputable school of podiatry for the purposes herein shall mean a school of podiatry requiring for graduation the graduation from an accredited high school, credits granted for at least two (2) full years of general college study in a college or university of recognized standing, and four (4) full years of study in such school of podiatry or its equivalent.

required.quote: shall have completed an accredited podiatric residency as defined by board rule

kind.quote: shall have completed an accredited podiatric residency as defined by board rule

exams.name: Competency Exam
exams.quote: Each applicant shall take and pass a competency exam approved by board rule. The examination shall test for entry level competency to provide podiatric medical services.

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this chapter shall be subject to biennial renewal

renewal_fee_usd.quote: A biennial renewal license fee established by board rule shall not exceed one thousand three hundred dollars ($1,300) for podiatrists.

required.quote: satisfactory evidence of having complied with continued education requirements as established by board rule are conditions precedent for issuance of a license

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant by endorsement where the applicant has passed an examination for and is currently licensed to practice podiatry in another state.

requirements.value: Must be currently licensed in another state and satisfy all other requirements for licensure in Idaho
requirements.quote: The applicant must satisfy in all other respects the requirements for licensure in this act and any rules adopted by the board.

exists.quote: The state board of podiatry, herein referred to as the board, shall have the following powers

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

credential_type.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

title_protection.quote: Any person who practices or attempts to practice podiatry, publicly advertises as a podiatrist, or who uses the title chiropodist, podiatrist, or any other word, title or abbreviation calculated to induce belief that he is engaged in the practice of podiatry, or who holds himself out to the public as diagnosing the ailments of or treating in any manner the human foot by medical, physical or surgical methods, without a license as provided in this act, shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of a crime deemed relevant under Idaho Code section 67-9411(1)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found guilty by a court of competent jurisdiction of a crime that is deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated and excessive abuse of drugs, alcohol, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to be a repeated and excessive abuser of any drug, including alcohol, or any controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the podiatry chapter or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to be in violation of any provision of this chapter or the rules promulgated pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used fraud or deception in procuring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have used fraud or deception in the procuring of any license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had adverse action taken by peer review body, health care institution, professional society, or court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have had any action, including denial of a license or the voluntary surrender of or voluntary limitation on a license, taken against the licensee by any peer review body, any health care institution, any professional medical society or association or any court, law enforcement or governmental agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unethical, unprofessional, or dishonorable conduct in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have been unethical, unprofessional or dishonorable in the practice of healing the sick

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order issued by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have failed to comply with an order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offered, gave, or promised any gift in return for procurement of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offer, give or promise, either directly or indirectly, any gift in return for the procurement of a patient or patients for podiatric treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requested, accepted, or received rebates or commissions for prescribing or recommending footwear, drugs, or other articles
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Request, list, accept or receive any rebates or commission for prescribing or recommending any footwear, drug, medicine, or any other article, to his patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed, dispensed, or used secret remedial agents or guaranteed treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribe, dispense or pretend to use, in treating any patient, any secret remedial agent, or manifest or promote its use in any way, or guarantee or imply to guarantee any treatment, therapy or remedy whatsoever

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used false, misleading, or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use any form of advertising that is false, misleading or deceptive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used improper title other than podiatrist or doctor of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use any title other than that of podiatrist or doctor of podiatric medicine; provided the term "foot specialist" or "physician and surgeon of the feet" may be used as explanatory terms of the title podiatrist but not alone or as a substitute therefor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed a solicitor to obtain business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ a solicitor or solicitors to obtain business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Published or used untruthful or improbable statements with intent to deceive or defraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publish or use untruthful or improbable statements with the intent of deceiving or defrauding the public or any patient

definition_quote.value: Podiatry shall mean the diagnosis and mechanical, electrical, medical, physical and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg, and the casting of feet for the purpose of preparing or prescribing corrective appliances, prosthetics, and/or the making of custom shoes for corrective treatment
definition_quote.quote: Podiatry shall, for the purpose of this chapter, mean the diagnosis and mechanical, electrical, medical, physical and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg, and the casting of feet for the purpose of preparing or prescribing corrective appliances, prosthetics, and/or the making of custom shoes for corrective treatment

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and mechanical, electrical, medical, physical and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg

drug_authority.value: A podiatrist may administer narcotics and medications in the treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg in the same manner as a physician and surgeon
drug_authority.quote: A podiatrist may administer narcotics and medications in the treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg in the same manner as a physician and surgeon licensed to practice under chapter 18, title 54, Idaho Code.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: Surgical treatment, as herein used, shall mean the surgical treatment of the foot and ankle and those soft tissue structures below the knee governing the function of the foot and ankle

amputation_authorized.quote: but shall not include the amputation of the leg, surgery of the knee joint, surgery of the bony structures proximal to the distal half of the tibia

anesthesia_authority.quote: but shall not include the amputation of the leg, surgery of the knee joint, surgery of the bony structures proximal to the distal half of the tibia, or the administration or monitoring of general anesthesia

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Surgical treatment, as herein used, shall mean the surgical treatment of the foot and ankle and those soft tissue structures below the knee governing the function of the foot and ankle

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Advanced surgical procedures, as determined by the state board of podiatry, shall be performed in a licensed hospital or certified ambulatory surgical center accredited by the joint commission on accreditation of healthcare organizations or the accreditation association for ambulatory health care where a peer review system is in place.

telehealth_authorized.quote: A provider delivering health care services via virtual care must at all times act within the scope of the provider's license and according to all applicable laws and rules

tibial_pilon_fracture_excluded.quote: but shall not include the amputation of the leg, surgery of the knee joint, surgery of the bony structures proximal to the distal half of the tibia

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: It is not the intent of this section, and nothing herein shall be so construed, to prohibit the sale of noncustom built shoes that are commonly sold by merchants in commercial establishments.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The board may refer a licensee who is chemically dependent or physically or psychologically impaired to a peer assistance entity.
